# subedit

These TypeScript modules come from the dependency-free SRT/VTT editor in
[hikashop-nicolas/subedit at 73d3a67](https://github.com/hikashop-nicolas/subedit/tree/73d3a67e4f814653bbe907ed6145270534273ce2).
The MIT license is included alongside the source.

The local adapter enables standalone SRT mode, Chinese labels and timecode
validation. In this mode the resource page owns saving and the editor displays
the cue list and text and timing fields.
